name: Reported Speech
description: Backshift of tenses, changes to pronouns and time expressions, reported questions, commands and requests, and reporting verbs with their patterns.

passages.title: A Message from the Coach
passages.content:
Yesterday our coach phoned me. He said that the match (1) ______ at ten on Saturday and told me (2) ______ my new boots, because the pitch would be wet.

He also asked if I (3) ______ a lift to the stadium. I said that my dad (4) ______ me. Before hanging up, he told me not (5) ______ late.

passages.title: The Job Interview
passages.content:
When Nadiya came home, her brother asked her how the interview (1) ______. She said that the manager (2) ______ her a lot of questions about her experience.

He had wanted to know why she (3) ______ to work for their company, and at the end he had asked her (4) ______ start in September. Nadiya told her brother that she (5) ______ hear from them by Friday.

passages.title: What the Museum Guide Said
passages.content:
On our trip to Kyiv, the museum guide told us that the building (1) ______ more than two hundred years old. She explained that it (2) ______ as a school for many years before it became a museum.

One of my classmates asked her whether photography (3) ______ allowed inside. The guide replied that we (4) ______ take photos, but without a flash. At the end she asked us which room we (5) ______ most.

passages.title: An Unexpected Apology
passages.content:
Last week my neighbour knocked on my door and said that he (1) ______ to apologise. He admitted that he (2) ______ my car the night before while he was parking.

I asked him why he (3) ______ me earlier. He explained that he (4) ______ to find me all morning, but nobody had answered the door. Then he suggested (5) ______ the repair together.

questions.title: 'I am tired,' she said. She said that she ___ tired.
questions.explanation: Present Simple у непрямій мові зсувається на Past Simple.

questions.title: 'We live in Kharkiv,' they said. They said that they ___ in Kharkiv.
questions.explanation: Present Simple зсувається на Past Simple: «live» стає «lived».

questions.title: 'I will call you,' he promised. He promised that he ___ me.
questions.explanation: «Will» у непрямій мові стає «would».

questions.title: 'I have finished,' she said. She said that she ___.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect зсувається на Past Perfect.

questions.title: In reported speech, what does 'tomorrow' usually become?
questions.explanation: «Tomorrow» у непрямій мові стає «the next day».

questions.title: In reported speech, what does 'here' usually become?
questions.explanation: «Here» у непрямій мові стає «there».

questions.title: 'Open the window,' he told me. He told me ___ the window.
questions.explanation: Наказ передають конструкцією «tell somebody to do something».

questions.title: 'Don't be late,' she warned us. She warned us ___ late.
questions.explanation: Заперечний наказ передають через «not to» + інфінітив.

questions.title: 'Where do you live?' he asked. He asked me where I ___.
questions.explanation: У непрямому питанні порядок слів прямий, а час зсувається.

questions.title: 'Are you coming?' she asked. She asked ___ I was coming.
questions.explanation: Загальні питання вводять сполучником «if» або «whether».

questions.title: Which word order is correct in a reported question?
options: He asked where the station was.
He asked where was the station.
He asked where did the station be.
He asked where is the station.
questions.explanation: У непрямому питанні зберігається порядок слів розповідного речення.

questions.title: 'I saw them yesterday,' he said. He said he ___ them the day before.
questions.explanation: Past Simple зсувається на Past Perfect, а «yesterday» — на «the day before».

questions.title: What is the difference between 'say' and 'tell'?
options: 'Tell' is followed directly by a person; 'say' is not.
'Say' is followed directly by a person; 'tell' is not.
They are interchangeable in every case.
questions.explanation: «Tell» вимагає адресата без «to», «say» — без адресата або з «to».

questions.title: 'Can you help me?' she asked. She asked me ___ help her.
questions.explanation: Прохання передають через «ask somebody to do something».

questions.title: Match each direct tense with the form it takes after backshift.
pairs: He said he had worked there.
He said he would work there.
questions.explanation: Кожен час зсувається на один крок назад.

questions.title: Match each time expression with the form it takes in reported speech.
questions.explanation: Обставини часу теж змінюються, бо змінюється точка відліку.

questions.title: Match each direct sentence with the reporting verb that suits it.
pairs: I am sorry I was rude.
questions.explanation: Точне дієслово введення передає не лише зміст, а й намір мовця.

questions.title: Match each direct question with its reported form.
pairs: She asked what my name was.
She asked where I had been.
She asked when I would return.
questions.explanation: У непрямому питанні зникає допоміжне «do» і зберігається прямий порядок слів.

questions.title: She admitted ___ the vase while cleaning.
questions.explanation: Після «admit» уживають герундій.

questions.title: He accused his colleague ___ the figures.
questions.explanation: «Accuse» вимагає конструкції «accuse somebody of doing something».

questions.title: The manager insisted ___ the report before Friday.
questions.explanation: «Insist» вимагає прийменника «on» і герундія.

questions.title: She suggested ___ the meeting until Monday.
questions.explanation: Після «suggest» уживають герундій, а не інфінітив із додатком.

questions.title: 'You should see a doctor,' he said. He ___ me to see a doctor.
questions.explanation: «Advise» вимагає конструкції «advise somebody to do something».

questions.title: Which sentence keeps the present tense correctly in reported speech?
options: She said the earth orbits the sun.
She said the earth orbited the sun as a fact.
She said the earth had orbited the sun always.
She said the earth would orbit the sun always.
questions.explanation: Незмінний науковий факт можна залишити в теперішньому часі.

questions.title: He denied ___ anything about the missing file.
questions.explanation: Після «deny» уживають герундій.

questions.title: 'Let's take a break,' she said. She ___ taking a break.
questions.explanation: Пропозицію «Let's» передають дієсловом «suggest» із герундієм.

questions.title: Which sentence about reported speech contains a mistake?
options: He said me that the shop was closed.
He told me that the shop was closed.
He said that the shop was closed.
He informed me that the shop was closed.
questions.explanation: «Say» не вживають із прямим додатком-особою: правильно «told me» або «said to me».

questions.title: They congratulated her ___ the scholarship.
questions.explanation: «Congratulate» вимагає прийменника «on» і герундія.

questions.title: She reminded me ___ the tickets before leaving.
questions.explanation: «Remind» вимагає конструкції «remind somebody to do something».

questions.title: He refused ___ any further comment on the matter.
questions.explanation: Після «refuse» уживають інфінітив із «to».

questions.title: 'I did not take it,' he said. He denied ___ it.
questions.explanation: Перфектний герундій «having taken» підкреслює, що дія була раніше.

questions.title: Match each reporting verb with the pattern it takes.
questions.explanation: Кожне дієслово введення має свою сталу конструкцію.

questions.title: Match each direct sentence with the reporting verb that captures its function.
questions.explanation: Дієслово введення точно передає намір і ставлення мовця.

questions.title: Match each reported structure with its direct original.
pairs: He offered to drive me home.
He agreed to drive me home.
All right, I will drive you.
He refused to drive me home.
No, I will not drive you.
He apologised for not driving me home.
Sorry I could not drive you.
questions.explanation: За конструкцією непрямої мови можна відновити пряму.

questions.title: Match each verb with the preposition its reporting pattern requires.
questions.explanation: Кожне дієслово введення вимагає свого прийменника.

questions.title: Match each faulty reported sentence with the reason it is wrong.
pairs: She asked me where was I going.
a reported question keeps statement order
suggest is not followed by an object plus infinitive
She told that she was busy.
say does not take a direct personal object
questions.explanation: Кожна помилка має свою причину: порядок слів, конструкція, наявність адресата.

questions.title: The witness maintained that he ___ nothing unusual that evening.
questions.explanation: Дієслово введення в минулому часі вимагає зсуву на Past Perfect.

questions.title: The spokesperson conceded ___ the delay had damaged public confidence.
questions.explanation: Після «concede» уживають підрядне речення зі сполучником «that».

questions.title: Which reporting verb best conveys a firm and repeated statement?
questions.explanation: «Insist» передає наполегливе й повторюване твердження.

questions.title: Which sentence reports a suggestion in the most formal register?
options: The board proposed that the scheme be reviewed annually.
The board proposed to review it every year maybe.
The board said review the scheme each year.
The board suggested them to review the scheme.
questions.explanation: У формальному стилі після «propose that» уживають форму без «to» й без -s.

questions.title: He implied ___ the decision had already been taken elsewhere.
questions.explanation: Після «imply» уживають підрядне речення зі сполучником «that».

questions.title: Which sentence shows the reporter distancing themselves from the claim?
options: The company allegedly withheld the results.
The company has withheld the results.
The company definitely withheld the results.
questions.explanation: «Allegedly» показує, що автор передає чуже твердження, не поділяючи його.

questions.title: Match each reporting verb with the attitude it signals.
questions.explanation: Дієслово введення виражає ставлення того, хто переказує.

questions.title: Match each formal reporting structure with its meaning.
pairs: It was alleged that funds were misused.
It was confirmed that funds were misused.
It was rumoured that funds were misused.
It was acknowledged that funds were misused.
questions.explanation: Формальні пасивні конструкції точно градуюють достовірність повідомлення.

questions.title: Match each nuance with the reporting verb that expresses it.
pairs: putting forward an idea for discussion
questions.explanation: Дієслова введення мови різняться відтінком: reiterated — повторив попри заперечення, noted — згадав побіжно.

questions.title: A Message from the Coach — gap 1
questions.explanation: Непряма мова після said: will переходить у would, далі інфінітив без to.

questions.title: A Message from the Coach — gap 2
questions.explanation: Прохання чи наказ у непрямій мові — told me to do.

questions.title: A Message from the Coach — gap 3
questions.explanation: Непряме питання має прямий порядок слів і зсув часу: if I needed.

questions.title: A Message from the Coach — gap 4
questions.explanation: Would + інфінітив без закінчень: would take.

questions.title: A Message from the Coach — gap 5
questions.explanation: Заборона в непрямій мові — told me not to do.

questions.title: The Job Interview — gap 1
questions.explanation: Непряме питання про минуле після asked — Past Perfect і прямий порядок слів.

questions.title: The Job Interview — gap 2
questions.explanation: Past Simple прямої мови в непрямій переходить у Past Perfect.

questions.title: The Job Interview — gap 3
questions.explanation: Непряме питання: прямий порядок слів без did, час зсувається — wanted.

questions.title: The Job Interview — gap 4
questions.explanation: Загальне питання в непрямій мові вводять whether/if, далі прямий порядок: whether she could.

questions.title: The Job Interview — gap 5
questions.explanation: Майбутнє в непрямій мові — would + інфінітив без to.

questions.title: What the Museum Guide Said — gap 1
questions.explanation: Непряма мова після told: is переходить у was; підмет building — одиничний.

questions.title: What the Museum Guide Said — gap 2
questions.explanation: Будівлю використовували до того, як вона стала музеєм: пасив у Past Perfect.

questions.title: What the Museum Guide Said — gap 3
questions.explanation: Непряме питання: прямий порядок слів і зсув часу — whether photography was allowed.

questions.title: What the Museum Guide Said — gap 4
questions.explanation: Can у непрямій мові переходить у could, після модального — інфінітив без to.

questions.title: What the Museum Guide Said — gap 5
questions.explanation: Непряме питання про вже побачене: прямий порядок слів і Past Perfect.

questions.title: An Unexpected Apology — gap 1
questions.explanation: Past Simple прямої мови (I came) після said переходить у Past Perfect.

questions.title: An Unexpected Apology — gap 2
questions.explanation: The night before — подія раніше за визнання: Past Perfect в активному стані.

questions.title: An Unexpected Apology — gap 3
questions.explanation: Непряме питання: прямий порядок слів без did і зсув у Past Perfect.

questions.title: An Unexpected Apology — gap 4
questions.explanation: Тривала дія до моменту розмови (all morning) — Past Perfect Continuous.

questions.title: An Unexpected Apology — gap 5
questions.explanation: Після suggest — герундій (або that-речення); suggest to do і suggest us to do неграматичні.
